messages:
Priya D.: Quick heads-up — I want to smoke-test a new q6b int4 build today. Need a small, tightly deduped promptset (no holdout leakage) to compare quality vs q6b-fp16. Can we pause ingest for 20m and run a fast fuzzy-dedupe + preserve long-context cases? cc @Maya C., @Ethan W.

curation-bot: ingest pause initiated by curation-bot — window=20m.

Maya C.: Got it. Recommended params: simhash + token-span norm. Short prompts thresh=0.86, multi-turn=0.80. Do you want to keep multi-turn sequences intact?

Priya D.: Keep multi-turn if turns>=3, else collapse. Whitelist any example with context_len>=512.

Ethan W.: Labeling FYI: we can allocate 2 labelers for a 2hr golden sprint for ~1k examples. Will create task once file is pushed.

Anna: I can do the sprint. Please include a brief rubric (accept/reject + hallucination severity + format check).

Olga P.: Add stress cases: long summaries (512-2k), code-only, and mixed-lang prompts — these tripped us on q4b.

Maya C.: Running dedupe now with: --short-thresh 0.86 --multi-turn 0.80 --whitelist-len 512 --method simhash+spannorm. Expect ~3k -> sample 1k golden + 2k holdout. Pushing artifacts to /mnt/curation/priya/1748509999/

curation-bot: uploaded deduped-3k.csv and golden-1k.csv (sha256: abc123...).

Ethan W.: Created label task LBL-17485099, assigned Anna + senior reviewer. ETA 6h for full pass. Will post results and then we run parity eval (token loss + top-k diffs). If regressions >3% on critical metrics, we halt rollout.

Priya D.: Thanks — also include a cache-disabled subset (200 examples) in eval matrix to catch kv-cache regressions. Kicking bring-up after labels are in. :rocket:
